headline: Lancashire Holdings Lifts Dividend, Sees High-Teens ROE in Q3 2026
summary: Lancashire Holdings raised its dividend and reported expectations for a high-teens return on equity during the third quarter of 2026.
why: Insurance companies report return on equity and dividend distributions as core metrics of underwriting profitability and shareholder value creation.
